description:
Extend the PlatformRegistry to support deployment mode awareness, enabling BenchBox
to model platforms with local/remote/managed variants (e.g., DuckDB → MotherDuck,
ClickHouse local → ClickHouse Cloud).

This is the foundational work that enables the deployment dimension architecture,
following the successful pattern of the SQL/DataFrame split. The registry will
declare deployment capabilities per platform, allowing the factory and CLI to
route to appropriate adapters.
